proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5401 article gives Malayalam vittu seed, semen; vitekka to sow seed; vita sowing, sowing season, grain sown; vitar seed.. The Malayalam survey form vittɯ “seed” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
